mainEntity.name: What web hosting services does RedSpider offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: RedSpider offers shared, VPS, cloud, dedicated and reseller hosting options for different website requirements. Domain registration and website management features are also available depending on the selected service.

mainEntity.name: What uptime does your hosting provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: If verified: RedSpider provides a 99.99% uptime commitment on applicable hosting services. Actual availability is also subject to maintenance, network conditions and the terms of the selected hosting plan.
SSL certificates are available with supported hosting plans to help encrypt data transferred between a website and its visitors. The exact SSL inclusion depends on the selected hosting package.

mainEntity.name: Can you migrate my existing website to RedSpider?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. RedSpider can assist with migrating eligible websites to a suitable hosting environment. Migration requirements depend on the website platform, files, databases, email configuration and current hosting setup.

mainEntity.name: Which type of hosting is right for my website?

acceptedAnswer.text: The right hosting option depends on your website size, traffic, resource requirements and required level of control. Shared hosting can suit smaller websites, while VPS, cloud or dedicated hosting may be more appropriate for websites with greater performance or technical requirements.

mainEntity.name: Can I use a domain registered with another provider?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. An existing domain can generally be connected to your hosting account by updating the required DNS settings. Our team can provide guidance based on your domain and hosting configuration.
